name: vwap_overshoot_fade_001_5s
author: adapted from gpt-5.4
thesis: This strategy exploits short-lived intraday dislocations away from session VWAP in liquid Indian equities when local price pressure outruns fair value. The inefficiency exists because opening inventory imbalances and retail chase flow create temporary overshoots in otherwise balanced tapes, and it persists because the edge is capacity-limited, regime-dependent, and disappears quickly on true news or trend days.
mechanism: VWAP is the institutional execution benchmark. When spot deviates significantly from session VWAP, algorithmic execution engines increase order flow to mean-revert their fills toward VWAP. This creates measurable gravitational pull, especially during lower-volume mid-session periods when fewer competing flows are present.

exit.signal_exit: exit when close crosses vwap OR rsi_fast crosses 55/45 against position

weaknesses: Performance is regime-dependent and weakens materially when session structure changes mid-trade.
Fast moves can create worse-than-assumed slippage and reduce realized edge versus paper assumptions.
Crowding risk can compress payoff and make execution quality unstable in the most obvious setups.
prior_art: Classic VWAP reversion with RSI/Bollinger confirmation
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; apply to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index instead of FnO universe; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
